evals.prompt: We're taking Orderly into Germany, the UAE and Pakistan next year. Here's the business-logic document: evals/files/sample-bld.md. What are we missing compared with a normal B2B wholesale ordering product, and what do we need for those markets specifically? Give me a prioritised list. Write it under docs/analysis/ in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: A report that states the domain (B2B wholesale ordering / order and stock management) and the BLD source; a prioritised P-xxx proposal list led by compliance items (multi-currency, tax-by-jurisdiction replacing the country conditional, invoicing and e-invoicing for UAE FTA / Pakistan FBR, data residency, local payment methods), then operational (returns/refunds, roles/permissions, time zones per customer), then expectation items; a country-specific section for DE, UAE, PK; a domain checklist table; a full i18n checklist table with every I18N-xx item classified PRESENT/PARTIAL/MISSING with BLD citations for PRESENT; UC-xxx findings for every PARTIAL/MISSING with all fields; a Beyond the checklist section.
expectations: Header states the confirmed domain, the source BLD path and the target markets Germany, UAE, Pakistan
Proposed use cases come before the checklist tables and findings
Every I18N item ID from references/i18n-checklist.md (A1..K4, 53 items) appears in the i18n results table with a status of PRESENT, PARTIAL or MISSING
Every PRESENT row cites a BLD workflow, rule (BR-xxx) or entity by name
Every PARTIAL/MISSING item has a UC-xxx finding containing all eight fields: ID, Label, Severity, Area, BLD reference, Location, Impact, Remediation

Proposal items are ordered with legal/compliance items (e.g. tax by jurisdiction, e-invoicing, data residency, multi-currency) before revenue/operational items before user-expectation items, and each states its priority basis and rationale
Every UC finding's Remediation cites a P-xxx item and every P-xxx lists the UC findings it resolves
Multi-currency is reported as MISSING or PARTIAL citing BR-012 (EUR only)
Tax-by-jurisdiction is reported as PARTIAL or MISSING citing BR-003 (hard-coded NL/BE/DE conditional)
Country-specific section mentions e-invoicing/fiscal obligations for UAE and Pakistan (FTA/FBR or equivalent) and German VAT invoice requirements
A Beyond the checklist section exists with at least one issue-format item
The document is written to docs/analysis/propose-use-cases/<date>.md and the reply states the path
Domain checklist rows carry stable DOM-xx IDs
Ten spot-checked findings have a BLD reference (BR-xxx, workflow or entity name) that exists in the sample BLD, or 'none'
Stated PRESENT/PARTIAL/MISSING counts for each checklist equal the number of rows with that status in the corresponding table

evals.prompt: are we ready to go international? do a gap analysis of our ordering app
evals.expected_output: No BLD was supplied. The skill must not proceed: it offers to generate one with explore-business-logic (if available) or asks for the BLD, and produces no analysis file.
expectations: The reply contains no checklist results, findings, severities or remediation plan - only the BLD offer/question - and no file is written under docs/
The response asks for a BLD or offers to generate one with explore-business-logic
The run halts after the offer: it does not analyse any application, repository or guessed product
